coach.name: Marcus Drake
coach.tagline: Evidence-based hypertrophy, fat loss recomposition, and elite athletic conditioning.
coach.bio: Marcus Drake is an NSCA Certified Strength & Conditioning Specialist (CSCS) with 11+ years transforming over 1,400 executives, collegiate athletes, and everyday lifters. His coaching methodology discards bro-science in favor of progressive overload, bioenergetic nutrition, and sustainable habits.

programs.name: 1-on-1 VIP Elite Coaching
features: Fully tailored progressive overload training program
Macro & micronutrient meal plan with weekly adjustments
Weekly 1-on-1 video form analysis & accountability audit
Direct 24/7 private WhatsApp messaging with Coach Marcus

programs.name: Hybrid Online Blueprint
features: Periodized 12-week hypertrophy or fat loss split
Bi-weekly digital check-ins with progress photo analysis
Exercise video library access for perfect lifting mechanics

programs.name: Executive Athletic Conditioning
features: In-person Miami private studio training sessions
Executive travel workout regimens for busy itineraries

transformations.name: Derek H., 38
transformations.quote: Marcus tailored everything around my grueling 60-hour work weeks. The energy and strength gains were remarkable.
